properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Package manager lifecycle hook spawns network-fetching shell or runtime
properties.description:
Detects the joint TTP behind every npm/PyPI/Composer supply-chain compromise of the last fortnight: a package manager process (npm/npx/yarn/pnpm/node/pip/python/composer) — invoked through an install or lifecycle hook (preinstall/postinstall) — spawns a script interpreter or downloader (powershell/pwsh/bash/sh/cmd/curl/wget/bun/bitsadmin/certutil) which then reaches a non-registry public destination within a 5-minute window. This fortnight the pattern drove the Mini Shai-Hulud Wave 4 worm in @tanstack and @antv packages (Snyk, Aikido, StepSecurity, Microsoft), the node-ipc maintainer compromise (Snyk, StepSecurity), the art-template watering-hole backdoor (Cyber Security News), the durabletask PyPI compromise (Microsoft), and the Packagist composer worm (The Hacker News) — all of which used lifecycle scripts to pull a secondary payload (typically the Bun runtime or a Linux ELF from GitHub Releases) before exfil'ing CI/CD secrets to git-tanstack.com, azurestaticprovider.net, m-kosche.com, git-service.com, or getsession.org. Kill-chain spans install (T1195.002, T1546.016, T1204.002) into c2 (T1071.001, T1105). Fires when a package install's lifecycle script spawns a fetcher AND that host beacons to a public non-registry host within 5 minutes; does NOT fire on interactive developer shells started outside an install context, nor on CI pipelines whose only egress is registry.npmjs.org / pypi.org / files.pythonhosted.org / repo.packagist.org / github.com/oven-sh release URLs that the org has explicitly whitelisted.

Rationale: Every article describes the same install-time chain: a compromised package's lifecycle script spawns an interpreter / downloader from inside an npm-pip-composer install context, then beacons to an attacker-controlled (non-registry) host within minutes. Joining the spawn event to a 5-minute non-registry egress window catches Mini Shai-Hulud (Bun fetched from GitHub Releases → m-kosche / git-tanstack / getsession C2), node-ipc (azurestaticprovider), durabletask (git-service.com), art-template (cfww.shop), and Packagist (parikhpreyash4 release) without depending on specific IOC values that rotate weekly.
properties.query:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let WindowMinutes = 5m;
let PkgMgrParents = dynamic(["npm.exe","npm-cli.js","node.exe","npx.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","python.exe","python3","pip.exe","pip3","composer","composer.phar"]);
let PkgMgrCmdHints = dynamic(["npm install","npm ci","npx ","yarn install","pnpm install","pip install","composer install","composer require","preinstall","postinstall","lifecycle"]);
let SuspChildren = dynamic(["powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","bash","bash.exe","sh","sh.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","bun.exe","bun","bitsadmin.exe","certutil.exe"]);
let RegistryHostsRe = @"(registry\.npmjs\.org|registry\.yarnpkg\.com|pypi\.org|pythonhosted\.org|packagist\.org)$";
let InstallSpawn = SecurityEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where EventID == 4688
    | extend ParentName = tostring(split(ParentProcessName,"\\")[-1])
    | extend ChildName  = tostring(split(NewProcessName,"\\")[-1])
    | where (ParentName in~ (PkgMgrParents)) or (CommandLine has_any (PkgMgrCmdHints))
    | where (ChildName in~ (SuspChildren))
         or (CommandLine has_any ("oven-sh/bun","releases/download","raw.githubusercontent.com","Invoke-WebRequest","DownloadString","curl -s","wget -q"))
    | where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
    | project SpawnTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentName, ParentProcessName, ChildName, NewProcessName, CommandLine;
let Egress = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where DeviceAction !in~ ("deny","drop","block")
    | where isnotempty(DestinationHostName) or isnotempty(RequestURL)
    | extend DestHost = coalesce(DestinationHostName, tostring(parse_url(RequestURL).Host))
    | where isnotempty(DestHost)
    | where not(DestHost matches regex RegistryHostsRe)
    | project EgressTime=TimeGenerated, SourceHostName, DestHost, DestinationIP, DestinationPort;
InstallSpawn
| join kind=inner (Egress | project-rename Computer=SourceHostName) on Computer
| where EgressTime between (SpawnTime .. SpawnTime + WindowMinutes)
| summarize FirstSpawn=min(SpawnTime),
            FirstEgress=min(EgressTime),
            UniqueDestHosts=dcount(DestHost),
            DestHosts=make_set(DestHost, 25),
            DestIPs=make_set(DestinationIP, 25)
        by Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentName, ChildName, CommandLine
| where UniqueDestHosts >= 1
| extend DelaySec = datetime_diff('second', FirstEgress, FirstSpawn)
| order by FirstSpawn desc
